title: Anthropic’s $1.5 trillion IPO exposes bankrupt FTX’s $40 billion missed fortune
summary: Anthropic shares owned by FTX and sold for around $2 billion would now be worth more than $40 billion as the artificial intelligence company finally goes public on Nov. 19.
